# California Literary Review

> > California Literary Review offers in-depth cultural criticism spanning television recaps, book reviews, film analysis, and performing arts coverage with a focus on British drama, historical non-fiction, and Bay Area culture.

This publication provides thoughtful commentary on popular television series (particularly BBC productions like Merlin, The Thick of It, and Doctor Who), historical and cultural scholarship, contemporary film, and regional arts events. The review style emphasizes narrative analysis, thematic exploration, and cultural context across diverse media forms.

## Key Topics

- BBC television drama
- Merlin and Arthurian legend adaptations
- British political satire
- Historical biography and cultural history
- Film and movie reviews
- San Francisco Bay Area performing arts
- Colorado cultural heritage
- Television series recaps and analysis
- Book reviews and literary criticism
- Fantasy and science fiction television
- Medieval and historical themes
- Contemporary cinema
- Dance and ballet coverage
- Cultural memory and preservation

## Television Recaps: British Drama

- [Merlin Recap: 'The Witchfinder' (Season 2, Episode 7)](https://calitreview.com/merlin-recap-the-witchfinder-season-2-episode-7): Merlin S2E7 recap analyzing witchcraft criminalization themes
- [Merlin Recap: 'Lancelot And Guinevere' (Season 2, Episode 4)](https://calitreview.com/merlin-recap-lancelot-and-guinevere-season-2-episode-4): Merlin S2E4 recap: Arthurian legend meets high-school drama format
- [Merlin Recap: 'The Nightmare Begins' (Season 2, Episode 3)](https://calitreview.com/merlin-recap-the-nightmare-begins-season-2-episode-3): Merlin S2E3 recap: Morgana's magic awakens with Druid intervention
- [The Thick Of It Recap – Series 4, Episode 4](https://calitreview.com/the-thick-of-it-recap-series-4-episode-4): BBC political satire recap: Malcolm Tucker's coup against Nicola Murray
- [The Thick Of It Recap – Series 4, Episode 1](https://calitreview.com/the-thick-of-it-recap-series-4-episode-1): BBC's Thick of It S4E1 recap: British political satire returns
- [Doctor Who Recap: 'A Town Called Mercy' (Season 33/Series 7, Episode 3)](https://calitreview.com/doctor-who-recap-a-town-called-mercy-season-33series-7-episode-3): Doctor Who S7E3 recap: Western-themed cyborg moral dilemma episode
- [Vegas Recap: Pilot Episode](https://calitreview.com/vegas-recap-pilot-episode): CBS Vegas pilot recap: 1960s Las Vegas period crime drama with Quaid

## Book Reviews: History and Biography

- [Marriage, A History: From Obedience To Intimacy, Or How Love Conquered Marriage](https://calitreview.com/marriage-a-history-from-obedience-to-intimacy-or-how-love-conquered-marriage): Stephanie Coontz's marriage history review: social institution evolution
- [Recovering The Past: A Historian's Memoir By Forrest McDonald](https://calitreview.com/recovering-the-past-a-historians-memoir-by-forrest-mcdonald): Review of historian Forrest McDonald's memoir on American history
- [Daughter Of Heaven By Nigel Cawthorne](https://calitreview.com/daughter-of-heaven-by-nigel-cawthorne): Review of Wu Chao biography: China's controversial female emperor
- [Erotic Art Of Ancient Pompeii](https://calitreview.com/erotic-art-of-ancient-pompeii): Review of Judith Harris' book on Pompeii's ancient erotic artwork

## Film and Cinema Reviews

- [Movie Review: Dark Shadows](https://calitreview.com/movie-review-dark-shadows): Tim Burton's Dark Shadows review: Johnny Depp's familiar gothic persona
- [Movie Review: The Amazing Spider-Man](https://calitreview.com/movie-review-the-amazing-spider-man): Amazing Spider-Man reboot review: Garfield & Stone anchor origin retread
- [Trailer Watch: Les Misérables](https://calitreview.com/trailer-watch-les-miserables): Les Misérables trailer analysis: Tom Hooper's Broadway-to-film adaptation

## Bay Area Performing Arts

- [Spines, Wines And Dragonflies: Groovin' In Stern Grove With The San Francisco Ballet](https://calitreview.com/spines-wines-and-dragonflies-groovin-in-stern-grove-with-the-san-francisco-ballet): SF Ballet's Stern Grove outdoor performance review featuring Balanchine
- [Bay Area Dancers Perform In A Benefit For Cancer Prevention](https://calitreview.com/bay-area-dancers-perform-in-a-benefit-for-cancer-prevention): Bay Area dance companies unite at Herbst Theater for cancer benefit

## Cultural Essays and Regional Features

- [Landscape And Memory: Wildfires Threaten Colorado's Built Heritage](https://calitreview.com/landscape-and-memory-wildfires-threaten-colorados-built-heritage): Colorado wildfires threaten I.M. Pei's Mesa Laboratory & NCAR facilities
- [A Place For Three Seasons: Crested Butte](https://calitreview.com/a-place-for-three-seasons-crested-butte): Personal essay on Crested Butte, Colorado's mountain town & skiing culture
